paragraphs: We love helping teens and adults throughout the community achieve beautifully straight smiles. We are your trusted orthodontist in Selma, NC.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our experienced team of orthodontic professionals, including an expert orthodontist in Selma, NC, is committed to providing exceptional orthodontic care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Our experienced team, featuring a skilled orthodontist in Selma, NC, is dedicated to providing exceptional orthodontic care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Selma office! Right at the intersection of Interstate 95 U.S. and Route 70, our Selma location provides care for the Selma community and for patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Smithfield, Wilson’s Mills, Goldsboro, and more. With our highly advanced technology and an experienced team, we provide the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, pain-free smile!

Our modern, inviting space is filled with a professional, experienced team that strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Walmart Shopping Center, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Selma office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Selma office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
At our office, we provide all the necessary treatments, including traditional metal and ceramic braces, Invisalign® clear aligners, retainers for maintenance, and more!

Caring for your braces is highly important to maintaining proper oral hygiene. Therefore, we will provide you with a special care kit with the necessary tools to take care of your braces properly. We also encourage you to brush your teeth after every meal to keep your smile bright and healthy.

For braces, you will typically visit every 4–8 weeks, while for Invisalign®, visits are usually every 6–10 weeks. For post-treatment retainers, visits are around 3–6 months to ensure proper maintenance.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Selma office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What orthodontic treatments are offered at Selma, NC, Orthodontics?

At our office, we provide all the necessary treatments, including traditional metal and ceramic braces, Invisalign® clear aligners, retainers for maintenance, and more!

How do I take care of my braces and teeth during treatment?

Caring for your braces is highly important to maintaining proper oral hygiene. Therefore, we will provide you with a special care kit with the necessary tools to take care of your braces properly. We also encourage you to brush your teeth after every meal to keep your smile bright and healthy.

How often do I need to visit Selma, NC, Orthodontics during treatment?

For braces, you will typically visit every 4–8 weeks, while for Invisalign®, visits are usually every 6–10 weeks. For post-treatment retainers, visits are around 3–6 months to ensure proper maintenance.

Do you accept dental insurance or membership plans for orthodontics?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
